title: Hicham El Guerrouj: Mile Master
description: Middle-distance royalty—records, tactics, and Olympic pressure.

questions.question: Which Moroccan runner held the 1500m world record for over 20 years?
El Guerrouj's specialty—the 1500m—is roughly how many laps on a standard track?
questions.explanation: On a 400m track, 1500m is three full laps plus 300 meters—one reason the start line sits on the back straight.

questions.question: Three and three-quarters laps of all-out effort—what was El Guerrouj's 1500m world record time?
questions.explanation: Set in Rome on July 14, 1998—and still the world record more than a quarter-century later.

questions.question: After his 3:26.00 world record, El Guerrouj finally won Olympic double gold in Athens in which two events?
questions.explanation: He fell in the 1996 final and lost to Noah Ngeny in 2000. In Athens he became the first man since Paavo Nurmi in 1924 to win both events at one Games.

questions.question: In that Athens 1500m and 5000m double, which Kenyan did he edge by just 0.12 seconds in the 1500m final?
